![Identica Credential Provider, Credential Provider. Password registration and login for your players, as a provider for Identica. Runs on Velocity and BungeeCord. Supported versions: 1.7+.](https://github.com/whereareiam/Identica/blob/dev/.github/assets/provider/credential/render/01-header.png?raw=true)

![Dependencies & Information. Identica: A provider for Identica. Put it into Identica's providers folder, from the same release as Identica. Passwords: Stored as bcrypt hashes by default, or Argon2id. Older hashes are upgraded when the player logs in. Good to know: Credential names are not case-sensitive, and a provider that owns its usernames can claim a name a Credential account holds; that account is then renamed.](https://github.com/whereareiam/Identica/blob/dev/.github/assets/provider/credential/render/02-board-dependencies-information.png?raw=true)

![Passwords done right. Players register with a password and log in with it, with rules and protection you configure. Registration: players repeat their password, which must follow your length and character rules. Lockout: 5 wrong passwords lock the account for 5 minutes by default, with warnings before. Change it: players change their password any time with a command.](https://github.com/whereareiam/Identica/blob/dev/.github/assets/provider/credential/render/03-feature-passwords-done-right.png?raw=true)

![Supports Identica's features. Verification: A second step such as TOTP after the login. Recognition: Returning players skip the full login while their signals match. Sentinel: Watches for repeated or risky actions. Restriction: Lets admins temporarily block new joins through this provider.](https://github.com/whereareiam/Identica/blob/dev/.github/assets/provider/credential/render/04-grid-supports-identica-s-features.png?raw=true)

![Getting started. Step 1, Install: Install Identica, then put Identica-Credential into its providers folder. Step 2, Start: Start the proxy once, then stop it. Step 3, Enable: Enable the provider in Identica's configuration and start the proxy.](https://github.com/whereareiam/Identica/blob/dev/.github/assets/provider/credential/render/05-steps-getting-started.png?raw=true)
